decisions.reason: As a publicly emphasized flagship tied to the firm's circular low-emission direction, the binder benefits from strong escalation of commitment, though its somewhat looser fit with the core machinery business keeps some withdrawal risk.
The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's core technology, was prominently launched, and has accumulated further commitment, so management is very likely to persist with it.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's decentralized recycling machinery strategy and prior public launch, making continued support more likely than withdrawal in a growing R&D-intensive firm.
